cohort: The study included 92 children aged 6 to 60 months from Wangaya Hospital, Denpasar, Bali, with 46 cases having fever and seizures, and 46 controls having fever but no seizures, excluding those with intracranial disorders, premature birth, or incomplete medical records.
finding: Exclusive breastfeeding was significantly associated with a reduced risk of febrile seizure in children aged 6 months to 5 years (OR 0.74; P=0.017), and a positive family history of FS was also a significant risk factor (OR 4.33; P=0.021).
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in delivery method between the case and control groups regarding the risk of febrile seizure.
birth_weight: Not specified as an inclusion criteria, but measured and found no significant difference between groups.
